title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-26
content:
Morning brain dump - blocks and priorities

Today goals:
- Finish PRD edits for streaming responses (section: failure modes + fallbacks). Need to add rollback steps and observability requirements.
- Sync with infra on dedicated capacity autoscale tests (2pm). Ask about 95th pct latency under mixed workloads.
- Follow up with legal on KMS options for private deployments (waiting on redlines).
- Prep launch checklist for hosted streaming feature (beta).

Top TODOs (in order):
1) PRD: update rollback plan + add canary % thresholds (TODO: write examples for 5/20/50% canary). Link to draft confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234.
2) Write short user-facing beta announcement copy for console + email (Elena to review).
3) Create eval prompt set for streaming regressions (Marcus to run baseline).
4) Add observability metrics: token-level latency, stream drop rate, prefix cache hit ratio. Decide retention window (14d vs 30d).
5) Follow-up: legal (KMS), infra (autoscale perf), SRE (rollback playbook).

Meeting notes - 10:00 sync with Eng (runtime + infra):
- Runtime team: streaming performance is promising on A100; need to validate on T4 and CPU fallback. Kernel selection improvements going into next deploy.
- Infra: running autoscale job tomorrow with 10k rps synthetic; expected to identify cold-start contours. Marcus to share results by EOD 3/27.
- Action items: runtime to add explicit metric for partial-response rate; infra to expose simulated region failover test.

PRD edits (quick diff notes):
- Intro: clarify scope = hosted API streaming responses only (no dedicated/private rollout yet).
- Add section "Failure modes and graceful degradation": describe model-variant fallback, truncate+resume behavior, client retry semantics, and expected error codes.
- Observability: add example Alert rule: "stream-drop-rate > 0.5% over 5m" -> page SRE + auto rollback.
- Rollout: recommend canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 12h bake per step and automated rollback on latency/regression.

Stakeholder follow-ups to send today:
- PM update to Growth and Sales: include estimated beta date, limitations, and expected latency numbers (p50/p95).
- Schedule 1:1 with Product Design to confirm UX for streaming indicators in console.

Launch checklist (beta internal):
- [ ] PRD final sign-off (Product, Eng, SRE)
- [ ] Beta announcement copy reviewed
- [ ] Migration guide for customers using dedicated capacity (notes about non-streaming support)
- [ ] Test plan: cross-region failover, rate-limit behavior, prefix cache correctness
- [ ] Instrumentation: token-level latency, stream-drop, per-route cost breakdown
- [ ] Canaries configured (5/20/100) + rollback triggers

Notes to self:
- Keep messaging conservative re: guaranteed latency. Call out p95 numbers by region.
- Remember to get legal confirmation before mentioning KMS support in external docs.
- Save a short howto for customers on migrating from non-streaming endpoints.

Quick links:
- Jira: PROD-4321 (streaming work)
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-1234
- GitHub PR: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR-987
- Slack thread: #prod-streaming (search "streaming beta")

End of day check (to fill in later):
- PRD edits pushed? (yes/no)
- Beta copy ready? (yes/no)
- Infra perf results? (yes/no)

Random thoughts / brainstorm bits:
- Could we expose a lightweight client-side SDK that resumes streams seamlessly on transient network errors? Pros: better UX for flaky mobile. Cons: complexity + state sync. Note for discussion with mobile SDK owner.

-- Aisha
